summary: Diversified Energy Company filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of oil and gas assets in east Texas (Cherokee, Harrison, Nacogdoches, Panola, Rusk counties) from Sheridan Holding Company III, LLC. The transaction closed on April 30, 2026 for a total purchase price of ~$248 million in cash, funded via borrowings under its senior secured revolving credit facility. The purchase agreement was previously filed as an exhibit to the February 26, 2026 8-K. This is a bolt-on acquisition of producing wells and leasehold. No advisor, premium, or break fee disclosed. Watch for completion of Item 9.01 financial statement filings and potential integration risk.
